summary: No invented or wrong conditions found; the most consequential issue is gonococcal conjunctivitis keying on a recorded recent STI diagnosis rather than recent STI symptoms, which can miss the intended patients. Minor imprecisions: stroke diagnosis omits TIA, 'whole' eyelid dropped for orbital cellulitis, 'no itch' stricter than 'no prominent itch', and localized rather than any enlarged lymph nodes; the page's 'localised cause likely' branch has no rule.
